column1: moderation§Moderation in the first four rounds is what let her still be standing in the ninth.§前四轮的**节制**，正是她到第九轮还站得住的原因。§moder（适度，同 modest 谦虚的）
modesty§Her modesty about the discovery was so complete that four colleagues assumed someone else had made it.§她对这项发现的**谦逊**如此彻底，四位同事都以为是别人做出的。§mod（分寸，同 mode 方式）
modicum§A modicum of preparation would have saved the meeting, and nobody had read past the agenda.§**些许**准备本可救下这场会议，而没人读过议程之外的东西。§
mollify§Nothing mollified the residents until the council agreed to move the depot rather than merely rebuild it.§直到议会同意迁走而不只是重建这座车场，居民才被**安抚**下来。§moll（柔软）→ 使变软
momentary§The failure was momentary and the consequences were not: nine seconds of darkness cost four hours of production.§故障是**瞬间的**而后果不是——九秒的黑暗损失了四小时的产量。§moment（片刻）
momentous§The decision looked routine and proved momentous, and only one person in the room voted against it.§这个决定看着例行公事，事实证明**极为重大**，屋里只有一人投了反对票。§moment（分量／动量）→ 有分量的
monarchical§The monarchical system survived four revolutions by giving up, each time, exactly the power in dispute.§这套**君主制**熬过四场革命，每一次都恰好交出争议中的那部分权力。§mon（单一，同 monopoly 垄断）+ arch（统治，同 anarchy 无政府）
monotonous§The work is monotonous rather than hard, and the error rate rises sharply after the fourth hour.§这项工作是**单调乏味的**而非辛苦的，错误率在第四小时后急剧上升。§mono（单一）+ ton（声调，同 tone 音调）
monumental§The monumental biography runs to nine hundred pages and stops four years before its subject's death.§这部**规模宏大的**传记长达九百页，却在传主去世前四年就停笔了。§monument（纪念碑）
mora§Latin verse counts by mora, and a syllable's weight matters more than the vowel a modern reader hears.§拉丁诗歌以**音拍**计量，音节的轻重比现代读者听到的元音更要紧。§
morbid§His morbid interest in the case unsettled colleagues who had worked on far worse ones without comment.§他对这个案子**病态的**兴趣让同事不安，而那些人办过更糟的案子却从不多言。§morb（疾病）
morbidity§Morbidity fell by a third and mortality did not, which tells you the treatment prevents illness rather than death.§**发病率**下降三分之一而死亡率没有，这告诉你这种疗法防的是病而非死。§
moribund§The industry was moribund by 1978 and employed, four decades later, more people than it ever had.§这个行业到 1978 年已**奄奄一息**，四十年后雇用的人却比历史上任何时候都多。§mori（死，同 mortal 会死的）
morose§He grew morose after the fourth rejection and wrote, in that mood, the book that finally sold.§第四次被拒后他变得**阴郁**，而正是在这种心境下写出了终于卖出去的那本书。§
mortality§Infant mortality here fell by half in nine years, and the cause was clean water rather than medicine.§这里的婴儿**死亡率**九年内下降一半，原因是清洁水而非医药。§mort（死，同 mortal 会死的）
motley§A motley crew of four teachers, a plumber, and a retired judge rebuilt the bridge in one summer.§一支由四位教师、一名管道工和一位退休法官组成的**杂凑**队伍，一个夏天重建了那座桥。§
muddle§The department muddled through nine months without a director, and nobody outside noticed anything at all.§这个部门在没有主管的情况下**将就混**过九个月，外面没人察觉任何异样。§
multifarious§Her multifarious duties at the school included teaching, fundraising, and, on four separate occasions, unblocking the drains.§她在这所学校**五花八门的**职责包括教学、募款，还有四次分别去疏通下水道。§multi（多）+ fari（种类）
multiplicity§The multiplicity of forms is the real barrier: nine agencies, nine formats, and one piece of information.§表格的**繁多**才是真正的障碍——九个机构、九种格式，而信息只有一条。§multi（多）+ plic（折叠，同 complicate 使复杂）
mundane§The most mundane detail broke the case: a parking receipt from a street four miles from the alibi.§最**平淡无奇的**细节破了案——一张停车收据，来自距不在场证明四英里的一条街。§mund（世界）→ 尘世的、俗常的
munificence§The munificence of one donor built the wing, and the plaque names a committee of nine instead.§一位捐赠者的**慷慨**建起了这座侧翼，而牌匾上写的却是一个九人委员会。§muni（礼物，同 munificent 慷慨的）+ fic（做）
munificent§The munificent offer came with four conditions, and the trustees accepted three and rejected the gift.§这份**慷慨的**馈赠附带四个条件，理事们接受了三个，然后拒绝了这份礼物。§
musing§Her musing, unhurried tone disguises an argument that turns out, on close reading, to be extremely precise.§她**沉思般**从容的语气掩盖了一个细读之下极为精确的论证。§
mute§The witness went mute at the fourth question and never spoke again in nine hours of hearing.§证人在第四个问题时**沉默不语**，此后九小时的听证中再没开过口。§mut（无声）
myopic§The strategy was myopic: it optimized one quarter and cost the company its position for four years.§这套战略是**目光短浅的**——它优化了一个季度，让公司四年失去了自己的位置。§myo（闭合）+ op（眼，同 optic 视觉的）
myriad§A myriad of small decisions, none of them wrong, produced a system nobody would have designed on purpose.§**无数**个小决定，没有一个是错的，却造出了一个没人会刻意设计的系统。§
mystical§His account of the experience is mystical, and the neurologists' account of it is not, and both may be right.§他对这段经历的叙述是**神秘主义的**，神经科医生的叙述不是，而两者可能都对。§
mystify§The instructions mystified everyone who had not built the machine, which was everyone who had to use it.§这些说明**难住**了每个没造过这台机器的人，也就是每个必须使用它的人。§
mythical§The founder's poverty is mythical: his letters show a bank balance that would have bought four houses.§创始人的贫寒是**虚构的**——他的信件显示的存款够买四栋房子。§
narcissism§The narcissism was not the problem; the problem was that it was rewarded for nine consecutive years.§**自恋**不是问题，问题是它连续九年得到奖赏。§Narcissus（恋上水中倒影的少年）
naturalistic§The naturalistic acting looked wrong in 1931 and looks like the only honest thing in the film today.§这种**自然主义的**表演在 1931 年显得别扭，如今看来是全片唯一诚实的东西。§
naysayer§Every naysayer on the committee turned out to have read a document the enthusiasts had not.§委员会里每一位**唱反调的人**，原来都读过热心者没读的一份文件。§nay（否）+ sayer（说话者）
nebulous§The plan is nebulous where it matters and precise about things nobody was worried about.§这个计划在要紧处**模糊不清**，对没人担心的事却精确无比。§nebul（云雾）
nefarious§The nefarious scheme was, in the end, four men and a photocopier in a rented office.§这个**穷凶极恶的**阴谋，说到底是租来的办公室里四个人加一台复印机。§ne（不）+ fas（合乎神法）
negate§One badly worded clause negates the protection that the other nine pages carefully construct.§一条措辞拙劣的条款**抵消**了其余九页精心构建的保护。§neg（否定，同 negative 否定的）
negligence§The negligence was corporate rather than personal, and no individual was ever charged with anything.§这起**疏忽**是公司层面而非个人的，从未有个人被指控任何罪名。§neg（不）+ leg（选择／关心，同 elect 选举）→ 不上心
negligent§The report calls four people negligent and the system sound, which reverses what the evidence shows.§报告称四个人**失职**而系统健全，这与证据显示的恰好相反。§
negligible§The difference is negligible in a single household and enormous across four hundred thousand of them.§这个差别在单个家庭里**微不足道**，在四十万家庭上则极为巨大。§
neutralize§Two spoonfuls of the powder neutralize the acid, and the whole clean-up takes about nine minutes.§两勺这种粉末就能**中和**这种酸，整个清理约需九分钟。§neutr（中立，同 neutral 中立的）
nihilistic§The novel's nihilistic ending was added by an editor, and the author's manuscript closes quite differently.§这部小说**虚无主义的**结尾是编辑加的，作者的手稿收尾截然不同。§nihil（无）
nitpicker§The nitpicker on the team caught four errors that would each have cost about a hundred thousand pounds.§团队里那个**吹毛求疵的人**逮到四处错误，每一处都会造成约十万英镑的损失。§nit（虱卵）+ pick（挑）→ 挑虱子卵
nomadic§The nomadic route has not changed in four centuries, and a new fence now crosses it in nine places.§这条**游牧的**路线四个世纪未变，如今一道新围栏在九处穿过它。§
nominal§The fee is nominal and the paperwork is not, which is why only nine people applied last year.§费用是**象征性的**而文书工作不是，所以去年只有九个人申请。§nomin（名字，同 nominate 提名）
nonchalance§His nonchalance about the deadline alarmed a team that had been working weekends for two months.§他对期限的**满不在乎**惊到了一个已经连着两个月加周末的团队。§non（不）+ chal（发热，同 calorie 卡路里）→ 不上火
nonchalant§She was nonchalant in public and, according to the letters, terrified for the whole of that autumn.§她在人前**若无其事**，而据书信所载，整个那个秋天她都惊恐不已。§
nondescript§The nondescript brick building on the corner housed the country's entire telephone exchange for nearly forty years.§街角那栋**毫无特色的**砖楼，近四十年里容纳着全国的电话交换中心。§non（不）+ descript（描述）→ 没什么可描述的
nonpartisan§The nonpartisan report was quoted by both sides, each of them stopping at a different paragraph.§这份**无党派的**报告被双方引用，各自都在不同的段落停下。§
nonplus§The question nonplussed a speaker who had prepared answers to about forty harder ones.§这个问题**难住了**一位已为约四十个更难问题准备好答案的演讲者。§
nonsensical§The rule is nonsensical as written, and four departments have quietly agreed to ignore it.§这条规则照字面看是**荒谬的**，四个部门已默契地决定无视它。§
nostalgia§Nostalgia for the old system is strongest among people who never actually had to use it.§对旧系统的**怀旧**在那些其实从未用过它的人当中最为强烈。§nostos（返乡）+ algos（痛）
nostalgic§The photographs are nostalgic and the captions are not, and the contrast is the point of the book.§这些照片是**怀旧的**而说明文字不是，这种对照正是全书的用意。§
notable§The most notable thing about the report is what it leaves out: four years and one entire department.§这份报告最**值得注意的**是它遗漏的东西——四年时间和整整一个部门。§not（记号，同 note 笔记）
noteworthy§It is noteworthy that all four objections came from people who would have to implement the change.§**值得注意的**是，四条反对意见全部来自必须执行这项改动的人。§
notoriety§The notoriety followed him for forty years, and the conviction behind it was quashed in 1971.§这份**恶名**跟了他四十年，而其背后的定罪早在 1971 年就被撤销。§not（记号，同 notorious 臭名昭著的）
notorious§The junction is notorious locally, and the council's own data show nine collisions in four years.§这个路口在本地**臭名昭著**，议会自己的数据显示四年发生九起碰撞。§
novelty§The novelty wore off in about a month, and the four hundred pounds it cost did not come back.§这份**新鲜感**约一个月就磨没了，而花掉的四百英镑回不来。§nov（新，同 novel 新奇的）
novice§A novice asked the question that four experienced engineers had stopped thinking to ask.§一位**新手**提出了四位资深工程师已经不再想到要问的问题。§nov（新）→ 新来的人
nuance§The nuance disappears in translation, and the English version says flatly what the original merely suggests.§这层**微妙差别**在翻译中消失了，英文版把原文只是暗示的东西说得直白。§
nudge§A well-placed nudge—moving the form to the top of the pile—raised completion rates by forty percent.§一次恰到好处的**轻推**——把表格挪到最上面——让完成率提高了四成。§
nullify§A single procedural error nullified nine months of work and sent the whole case back to the beginning.§一处程序错误让九个月的工作**归于无效**，整个案子被打回原点。§null（无，同 null 无效的）+ fy（使）
nurture§The department nurtured four unusual careers by leaving unusual people alone for long enough.§这个系**培育**了四段不寻常的职业生涯，办法是让不寻常的人独处得够久。§nutri（滋养，同 nutrition 营养）
obdurate§The landlord was obdurate about the rent and, on every other question, remarkably easy to deal with.§房东在租金上**冥顽不化**，在其他每个问题上都出奇地好说话。§ob-（对着）+ dur（坚硬，同 durable 耐久的）
obfuscate§The report obfuscates a simple fact: nine of the eleven sites failed the same test in the same month.§这份报告**故意搅浑**了一个简单事实——十一个厂区中有九个在同一个月未通过同一项测试。§ob-（遮盖）+ fusc（暗）
obfuscation§The obfuscation is deliberate, and the clearest sentence in nine pages is the one nobody disputes.§这种**含混其辞**是刻意的，九页里最清楚的一句是没人有异议的那句。§
objectivity§Objectivity here does not mean neutrality: it means saying which of the two accounts the evidence supports.§这里的**客观**不等于中立——它意味着说出证据支持两种说法中的哪一种。§
obligatory§The consultation is obligatory and the outcome is not binding, which explains the four-percent response rate.§这项咨询是**强制性的**而结果没有约束力，这解释了百分之四的回复率。§ob-（向）+ lig（捆绑，同 ligament 韧带）
